role: Calibration DEV only, no TEST, refit, policy training or new physical episodes
metric: Maximum over time, every collision geom, lower/upper x/y support discrepancy. Inflating each predicted planar AABB by this observed error encloses actual AABBs. Applicable to current axis-aligned road/forbidden rectangles only, not general 3D geometry or probabilistic safety.
margin_rule: For each method/horizon take maximum across DEV group P95 support error, plus .02m declared map/discretization allowance. Keep prior global3D bound for comparison; do not select by E1 success.
budget: One saved-data evaluation with 225 free prediction steps each, no sweep or retries
scope: Reset+20ms anchors only; no claim of rolling-state/history coverage. Partial/missing windows are reported, not padded.
